argument.description: Your reasoning this round, in markdown. Argue; do not ratify.

staged_plan.description: The COMPLETE plan as you would have it, in markdown — not a diff and not commentary. If you would leave it unchanged, return it unchanged.

disagreements.description: One line each. Specific points you dispute, most important first.

because.description: A further round is justified only by NEW EVIDENCE, a CONCRETE COUNTEREXAMPLE, or a BOUNDED FALSIFIABLE PROPOSAL — and it must be something the NEXT round would carry, not what you just delivered. Remaining disagreement is not a reason. Name which of the three you hold, or say you hold none.
